summary: Cantor Equity Partners VII, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering (IPO) on June 18, 2026, offering 25 million Class A ordinary shares at $10.00 per share, generating $250 million in gross proceeds. Simultaneously, it completed a private placement of 600,000 shares to its sponsor, Cantor EP Holdings VII, LLC, for $6 million. Net proceeds of $250 million ($10.00 per public share) were deposited into a trust account with Continental Stock Transfer Trust Company. An audited balance sheet as of the closing date was included. This is a standard SPAC IPO filing; the trust structure is typical for blank-check companies. No business combination target has been announced. Watch for future disclosure of a de-SPAC transaction and shareholder vote.
